Alice M.: Quick sync — signal/orchestration probe for API v2 is scheduled Tue 09:00 PT. We need: 1) lane owners (canary/fastpath/edge), 2) any SDK header mismatches, 3) dep services that will need feature flags. @Ben K. @Carol S. assigning.

Ben K.: I'm happy to own canary lane. Will coordinate with infra for extra capacity. Which slice sizes are we using?

Carol S.: I can take 'edge' (legacy clients). FYI client header parity bug I saw: older python SDK doesn't send emb-version header.

Derek (eng-platform): Noted. infra needs a list of endpoints that will require header coalescing. Can you paste sample failing request?

Alice M.: Here — reproducer from prod-capture:
```http
POST /v1/completions HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer x...
Content-Type: application/json
User-Agent: redwood-py/0.9.1
```
Old SDK missing `X-Redwood-Emb-Version` header so server falls back to v1 routing.

Ben K.: ok canary capacity set to 4 gpus per zone. I'll add smoke job:
```
make smoke-run CANARY=true SLICES=100
```
Expect ~10m run.

Carol S.: SDK fix is a small patch — PR queued: #4821. Will patch release tomorrow EOD.

Alice M.: Derek — can infra add a routing fallback that emits a metric `compat.missing_header`? Need alert if >0.1% of traffic.

Derek (eng-platform): Added to infra backlog. If you want alert today, I can add a temporary rule: `compat.missing_header > 100` per 5m. ok?

Ben K.: yes + also add tag `lane:canary` to the smoke job logs.

k8s-deploy-bot: deploy started for canary-lane-1 at 2024-04-12T09:10:22Z :rocket:

Alice M.: Thanks everyone. Quick asks: Ben plz post smoke run link when done. Carol plz ping here when PR is merged so I can flip canary flag. I'll create a short runbook for rollback.
